name: 2023 Pokémon World Championships Yokohama Deck: Pikachu

releases.name: 2023 Pokémon World Championships Yokohama Deck: Pikachu

description.text: A ready-made deck released in Japan on 28 July 2023, alongside Ruler of the Black Flame, for the 2023 World Championships in Yokohama on 11 to 13 August, the first World Championships held in Japan. It is built around a Pikachu ex with new special illustration art of Pikachu battling Koraidon and Miraidon in a tournament, embossed with a 2023 World Championships stamp, with Pawmot, Kilowattrel, Annihilape and Trainers such as Nemona and Professor's Research. It came in an aluminium deck tin with a yellow Pikachu coin, 64 Worlds-themed sleeves and damage and status markers.
